result.instructions: Tools for Kolleno, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers have overdue invoices, and how much do they owe?"; "Show the open invoices for this customer and their payment status."; "Pause chasing on this invoice until the promised payment date.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kolleno data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kolleno_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kolleno_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kolleno_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kolleno_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kolleno_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies this API key can access. Call this first: most other tools need a company id. Open API: GET /v1/company/.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company by id: name, address and currency. Open API: GET /v1/company/{id}/.

tools.name: kolleno_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers of a company, with balance, warning level and chasing status. Filter by your own external reference or source id. Open API: GET /v1/customer/{company}/.

ref.description: Filter by the customer reference (your own code).

source_id.description: Filter by the source system id.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return (Kolleno field selection).

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: balance, currency, pause_chasing, warning_level, tags and extra_data. Open API: GET /v1/customer/{company}/{id}/.

tools.name: kolleno_get_customer_portal_url
tools.title: Get customer portal link
tools.description: Get the link to the customer's self-service portal (where they can view invoices and pay). The link is for the customer only. Open API: GET /v1/customer/portal-url/{company}/.

source_id.description: Customer source id, instead of customer_id.

tools.name: kolleno_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices of a company. Filter by customer, payment status, last modified time or your own external id. Start here to find overdue invoices (payment_status). Open API: GET /v1/invoice/{company}/.

customer_id.description: Only invoices of this customer id.

payment_status.description: One payment status value, as Kolleno names it (e.g. open, paid).

date_modified_gte.description: Only invoices modified at or after this ISO 8601 time.

source_id.description: Filter by the source system id.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: amount, balance, due date, payment status, pause_chasing, persons and tags. Open API: GET /v1/invoice/{company}/{id}/.

tools.name: kolleno_list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes
tools.description: List the credit notes of one customer. Open API: GET /v1/credit-note/{customer}/.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_get_credit_note
tools.title: Get a credit note
tools.description: Get one credit note of a customer by id. Open API: GET /v1/credit-note/{customer}/{id}/.

tools.name: kolleno_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List the payment transactions of one customer (money received or sent against the account). Open API: GET /v1/transaction/{customer}/.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_list_matches
tools.title: List payment matches
tools.description: List the matches between bank payments and invoices of a company (reconciliation). Filter by status, bank account or modified time. Open API: GET /v1/match/{company}/.

status.description: Match status, as Kolleno names it.

date_modified_gte.description: Modified at or after this ISO 8601 time.

date_modified_lte.description: Modified at or before this ISO 8601 time.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_get_match
tools.title: Get a payment match
tools.description: Get one payment match by id. Open API: GET /v1/match/{company}/{id}/.

tools.name: kolleno_list_customer_persons
tools.title: List contacts of a customer
tools.description: List the contact persons (name, email, phone) of one customer. Open API: GET /v1/person/{customer}/.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_list_emails_sent
tools.title: List chasing emails sent
tools.description: List the chasing emails Kolleno sent: to which customer, for which invoice, and at which step. Open API: GET /v1/email-sent/{company}/.

customer_id.description: Only emails to this customer id.

invoice_id.description: Only emails about this invoice id.

step.description: Only emails sent at this workflow step id.

date_sent_gte.description: Sent at or after this ISO 8601 time.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of a company, which label customers and invoices. Open API: GET /v1/tag/{company}/.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_list_workflows
tools.title: List chasing workflows
tools.description: List the chasing workflows of a company and whether each is active. Open API: GET /v1/workflow/{company}/.

is_active.description: Only active (true) or only inactive (false) workflows.

limit.description: Page size. Kolleno applies its own default when omitted.

offset.description: Results to skip, for offset pagination (default 0).

tools.name: kolleno_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer in a company. Only name is required. Use source_id to keep your own id for the customer. Open API: POST /v1/customer/{company}/.

source_id.description: Your own id for this customer.

tools.name: kolleno_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Change selected fields of a customer, such as pause_chasing, warning_level or the address. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Does not change extra_data (use kolleno_update_customer_custom_fields). Open API: PATCH /v1/customer/{company}/{id}/.

tools.name: kolleno_update_customer_custom_fields
tools.title: Update customer custom fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one customer (for example upsell: true, amount_requested: 10.12). Only the keys you send change. Open API: PATCH /v1/customer/custom-fields/{company}/{customer}/.

fields.description: Custom field names and values to set.

tools.name: kolleno_update_invoice
tools.title: Update an invoice
tools.description: Change selected fields of an invoice: pause_chasing (stop or restart chasing), date_due or description. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Does not change the payment status or extra_data. Open API: PATCH /v1/invoice/{company}/{id}/.

date_due.description: New due date, yyyy-mm-dd, or null to clear it.

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.name: list_overdue_invoices_and_what_they_owe
prompts.title: List overdue invoices and what they owe
prompts.description: List the companies, then list invoices by payment status. Open one invoice for its balance, due date and contact persons.

prompts.name: review_a_customer_s_balance_and_chasing_status
prompts.title: Review a customer's balance and chasing status
prompts.description: List the customers with their balance, warning level and chasing status. Open one customer and list its contact persons.

prompts.name: check_chasing_emails_and_workflows
prompts.title: Check chasing emails and workflows
prompts.description: List the chasing emails sent to a customer, with the invoice and step. List the chasing workflows and whether each is active.

prompts.name: reconcile_bank_payments_with_invoices
prompts.title: Reconcile bank payments with invoices
prompts.description: List payment matches between bank payments and invoices. Open one match. Read the payment transactions of a customer.

prompts.name: pause_chasing_or_change_an_invoice_due_date
prompts.title: Pause chasing or change an invoice due date
prompts.description: Stop or restart chasing on an invoice. You can also change its due date or description. Fields you leave out stay the same.

prompts.name: set_custom_fields_on_a_customer
prompts.title: Set custom fields on a customer
prompts.description: Read the customer first. Then set custom field values on it. Only the keys you send change.
